task: Fix the bulk budget override modal so focusing the Hard/Soft limit inputs keeps their initial values and no longer shows non-negative validation errors, while still validating genuinely invalid input (EPMCDME-16069).

key_reasoning.reason: Root cause is confirmed in BulkBudgetOverrideModal's focus handlers and AC1-AC4 are explicit. Two decisions are still open: how a Mixed field behaves once cleared (empty means unchanged, or an error), and AC4 is only partly reachable because the Input keyfilter strips '-' and letters, so its invalid cases fall back to empty or '.' input.

The closest pattern is MemberAllocationOverrideModal's touched/initial-draft gating, which is well established. Risk is low on its own, with possible regressions in Mixed-field handling and Save Override gating. Bumped S->M because the AC lists specific error and variant cases and no test template covers them: BulkBudgetOverrideModal has no test file, its parent suites mock it out, and the single-member modal test has no focus or validation assertions.

The fix is confined to BulkBudgetOverrideModal (focus handlers and validation memo), possibly with a small touch to the shared BudgetOverrideCategoryCard. Both are in the UI layer. Calibration: matches the bundled S example epmcdme-10102 (11 points, add validation to form field).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk auto-bumped from S to M: the AC enumerate edge/error cases (AC3, AC4) and no existing test template covers error-path assertions for the bulk modal
